title: Cyber Resilience 2027: What Leaders Need to Know Now | World Economic Forum
author: SK
text: Cybersecurity has reached a strategic inflection point. No longer solely a technical or compliance issue, it is becoming a critical determinant of economic continuity, organizational resilience and global stability.Drawing on insights from the World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council on Cybersecurity, this session explores the leadership priorities shaping the cybersecurity agenda for 2027. Experts discuss how organizations can build a common language around cyber risk, treat cybersecurity as a value-creating investment, strengthen resilience mechanisms and support more coordinated action across business and government.What should leaders prioritize now to prepare for the next era of cyber resilience?This is the full audio from a video session recorded on 21 October, available to watch for World Economic Forum partners and digital members.To become a digital member: https://www.weforum.org/join-us/individuals/Digital members can watch the session here: https://toplink.weforum.org/sessions/a0WTG000001rJYb2AM/cyber-resilience-in-2027-what-leaders-need-to-know/participantsFollow this topic.
